jobs.title: System Performance Optimization Technical Manager_HsinChu
jobs.description:
Lead the team in analyzing and optimizing gaming performance on mobile SoC platforms, and develop optimization technologies to achieve project targets.

Lead the team in analyzing gaming performance bottlenecks and power consumption based on game behavior, and achieve the goal of enhancing the gaming experience on MediaTek platforms through software optimization and tuning.
Lead the team to collaborate with game studios, providing recommendations for gameplay experience optimization based on game behavior analysis.
Lead the team in achieving product performance and power efficiency targets for MediaTek and client projects through software tuning.
